goals: Maintain the Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric integration layer between the canonical Mynx-maintained Ribbits line and Matcha Flavoured.

Make Ribbits participate intentionally in Matcha progression, villager economics, discovery, and other explicitly approved cross-system behavior without turning either project into a general overhaul of the other.
scope: Begin implementation only after the canonical Ribbits 26.2 project has a runtime-functional candidate and the exact current Matcha integration surfaces required by the chosen workstream can be audited.

Audit Matcha's authoritative villager-trade ownership and the exact current trade table before adding, deriving, or mapping any Ribbits-facing Matcha trade behavior; use supported server-authoritative hooks and do not rely on ignored or unassigned trade resources.

Retain the original explorer-map concept as an initial workstream: add a distinct Ribbit Village Explorer Map to Matcha cartographer progression without replacing Matcha's existing swamp-hut explorer map or unrelated cartographer offers.

Support explicitly approved Matcha-derived trade mappings for appropriate Ribbit professions, documenting whether each mapping is a frozen intentional design or an integration that tracks a defined Matcha contract; do not blanket-mirror Matcha's entire trade table by default.
Keep behavior intrinsic to Ribbits itself in the canonical Ribbits project; this project owns only behavior whose purpose depends materially on both Ribbits and Matcha.
Allow future Matcha-specific Ribbits integration workstreams to be added within this project when they cross the same ownership boundary and are individually documented, tested, and versioned.
Preserve Matcha's unrelated progression, Ribbits' unrelated native behavior, villager restocking and persistence, save/reload behavior, and dedicated-server compatibility.

exclusions: Implementation source, build files, generated resources, artifacts, Canary versions, or speculative scaffolding while the project remains PLANNED.

Ribbits-native features that do not materially depend on Matcha, including standalone Ribbit AI, profession behavior, village composition, world generation, items, or independently designed trades; those remain owned by the canonical Ribbits project.

Unrelated Matcha changes, a general Matcha villager-trade overhaul, blanket replacement of Matcha trade sets, or modification of Matcha progression beyond the explicitly approved Ribbits integration behavior.
Automatic mirroring of every current or future Matcha trade without an explicit mapping contract and compatibility rationale.
Replacing swamp huts with Ribbits villages, suppressing either structure's independent world generation, sharing one structure identity, or repurposing Matcha's existing swamp-hut explorer map.
Copying or redistributing protected Ribbits or private Matcha material beyond what is lawfully available and necessary for local compatibility work.
Deployment, Test Slot occupancy, Minecraft launch, runtime-state mutation, protected gameplay-instance access, or runtime-validation claims during conceptual planning.

dependencies.requirement: A runtime-functional canonical Minecraft 26.2 Ribbits release with the exact entities, professions, village structure identity, and integration surfaces required by the implemented workstream.
dependencies.reason: Cross-system behavior must extend the canonical Ribbits implementation without duplicating or taking ownership of its native content.
Exact game target whose villager trades, explorer maps, structure locate behavior, persistence, and server contracts must be respected.
Minecraft 26.2 Fabric loader baseline for the eventual compatibility implementation.
Current Fabric API baseline; supported trade, lifecycle, networking, and other integration hooks should be preferred where applicable.

dependencies.requirement: The exact current Minecraft 26.2 Matcha Flavoured stack and authoritative integration contracts must be audited before each implemented workstream.
dependencies.reason: This project exists specifically to integrate Ribbits with Matcha behavior rather than to reproduce an assumed or stale Matcha contract.

state.milestone: The Ribbits Village Explorer Map concept has been repurposed in place as the general Ribbits × Matcha Integration project while preserving its immutable UUID, stable repository project ID/path, and PLANNED lifecycle. The explorer map remains the first named workstream, and selected Matcha-derived Ribbit trade mappings plus future explicitly approved cross-system features are now in scope; no implementation or runtime candidate exists.
